summary: Teaching phase-distortion synth: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. A cosine read through a bent phase (six read geometries: saw, square, narrow pulse, double sine, saw-pulse, trapezoid) whose bend decays on each note, a hard-synced resonant window, a ring modulator and a warm chorus, with an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for rubbery basses, digital plucks, glassy keys and screaming sweeps, or to learn how bending the phase of a sine makes harmonics.
use_for: A teaching phase-distortion synth: rubbery basses, digital plucks and glassy keys from a bent cosine with six read shapes, a decaying bend, a resonant sweep, ring modulation and a warm chorus.

parameters.name: Phase Bend
parameters.description: Bends the speed at which each cycle reads a cosine: 0% reads it evenly (a pure sine), 100% reads part of the cycle much faster than the rest.
parameters.how: Bends the speed at which each cycle reads a cosine: 0% reads it evenly (a pure sine), 100% reads part of the cycle much faster than the rest.
parameters.sound: Acts like a low-pass filter cutoff without using a filter—opening from a pure, round sine into a sharp, buzzy wave.

parameters.name: Resonance
parameters.description: Multiplies the frequency of a hard-synced cosine window inside the single-cycle phase reset.
parameters.how: Multiplies the frequency of a hard-synced cosine window inside the single-cycle phase reset.
parameters.sound: Produces the unmistakable, vocal, screaming 1980s digital filter sweep resonance.

parameters.name: PD Wave
parameters.description: Selects the phase-read geometry (`Sawtooth`, `Square`, `Narrow Pulse`, `Double Sine`, `Saw-Pulse`, `Trapezoid`).
parameters.how: Selects the phase-read geometry (`Sawtooth`, `Square`, `Narrow Pulse`, `Double Sine`, `Saw-Pulse`, `Trapezoid`).
parameters.sound: Sets the fundamental harmonic character that emerges as Phase Bend is turned up.

parameters.name: Bend Decay
parameters.description: Sets the decay speed of the dedicated envelope modulating `phase_bend` on each note trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the decay speed of the dedicated envelope modulating `phase_bend` on each note trigger.
parameters.sound: Creates punchy, rubbery 80s synth basses and bright digital plucks that warm up as they sustain.

parameters.name: Ring Mod
parameters.description: Multiplies the primary phase-distorted wave with a secondary carrier oscillator.
parameters.how: Multiplies the primary phase-distorted wave with a secondary carrier oscillator.
parameters.sound: Adds clangorous, bell-like, and harmonically complex retro digital overtones.

parameters.name: Chorus
parameters.description: Engages a warm, slightly noisy bucket-brigade stereo delay chorus on the output.
parameters.how: Engages a warm, slightly noisy bucket-brigade stereo delay chorus on the output.
parameters.sound: Widens dry digital waveforms into lush, nostalgic 80s synth keys and pads.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.
